description: This file is a server-side route handler for managing tags within a SvelteKit application. It handles loading tags, and performing create, update, archive, and restore actions via API requests related to tags.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads tags data, requires admin role, fetches tags including archived, handles errors.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new tag with provided name, color, description; validates input, handles errors.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing tag identified by tagId, with new name, color, description; validates input.

methods.name: archive
methods.description: Archives (deletes) a tag identified by tagId.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores a previously archived tag identified by tagId.
